Avadh Ojha joins us in Guest in the Newsroom Show. Avadh Ojha is a well known educator, entrepreneur, counselor and Indian youtuber. In the latest episode of Guest in the Newsroom, Avadh Ojha talks about his opinion on Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Nehru and Mahatma Gandhi. He also talks about his controversial video clips on Shri Krishna, his chemistry with Khan Sir and Vikas Divyakirti. Avadh Ojha also shared if he is planning to join BJP in near future or not and many more. Watch the Editor of Lallantop Saurabh Dwivedi in conversation with Avadh ojha.
Produced By: The Lallantop
